independent_check.polynomial_partition: For an original leaf v with support s, independent sets avoiding v contribute I_(T-v)(z). Independent sets containing v correspond bijectively, after deleting v, to independent sets in T-{v,s}; hence I_T(z)=I_(T-v)(z)+z I_(T-{v,s})(z).
independent_check.coefficient_identity: Writing i_j(G)=0 outside the feasible range, i_j(T)=i_j(T-v)+i_(j-1)(T-{v,s}) for every integer j. Subtracting the identity at j from that at j+1 gives Delta_j(T)=Delta_j(T-v)+Delta_(j-1)(T-{v,s}).
independent_check.sign_alternative: If Delta_x(T)<0, the two integer terms in the identity at x cannot both be nonnegative. Thus at least one is strictly negative, separately for each original leaf v. Equal supports do not identify or remove tags.

example_check.eligibility: For p=3 and alpha=3, 3p=9 is not less than 2alpha+1=7; therefore this is not an eligible primary instance.

audit_boundary: The exact identity and local sign alternative are established. They do not imply a sign at p>=x+2 for the selected leaf deletion, and do not prove or refute the aggregate. The cited literature boundary was not independently needed or relied upon in this audit.
